messages:
alex.chen: kicking off RC origination for rc-2026. details in the release notes draft.
maya: looks good. build passed CI and perf smoke is green.
sam.g: can we pin the backend model bundle to v2.4.1 to avoid surprises? :point_up:
alex.chen: yes pin to v2.4.1, add note about db migration flag off for this window.
eva.p: +1. product signoff from my side for the feature flags.
product-ops: change window is 2026-03-20 18:00-20:00 UTC. keep quiet window for 15m after promo.
sre-oncall: I'll be sheriff for the window. Roland is backup. Set me as rollback owner.
deploy-bot: rc created: rc-2026-03-20-451 (build 451). staged deploy scheduled to staging at 18:05 UTC.
alex.chen: staging smoke then kv-warm; run canary with 2% traffic for 10 minutes.
maya: starting smoke now.
deploy-bot: staging deploy started.
deploy-bot: staging smoke: 34/34 checks passed.
sam.g: kicking canary now: `/deploy promote --rc rc-2026-03-20-451 --env canary --traffic 2%`
alex.chen: observed +10ms p90 on embeddings path, still within SLO.
eva.p: noted. alert thresholds okay.
sre-oncall: telemetry hooks set; if error rate > 0.5% for 3m we rollback immediately.
deploy-bot: canary promote done. traffic 2%.
maya: canary health 3m OK. no errors, latency stable.
product-ops: docs and release notes published: https://go/release/rc-451
alex.chen: ready for prod promo unless any objections.
sam.g: approve from infra.
eva.p: approve from product.
sre-oncall: approve. I'll do the monitor callout and be on pager.
alex.chen: promoting to prod in 2 minutes. pinned model v2.4.1 in promo config.
deploy-bot: PROD promotion initiated.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy success: rc-2026-03-20-451 -> prod. traffic ramping to 100% over 10m.
sre-oncall: monitoring. if we see regressions trigger rollback by commenting `!rollback rc-2026-03-20-451` here.
alex.chen: thanks everyone. will open post-deploy checklist and followup for perf regression mitigation.
product-ops: sending customer comms now :email:
sre-oncall: all green at 10m mark. handing off sheriff to next shift.
alex.chen: closing thread, will file formal release notes in GH.
